name: zmath_mat_transform_normal_batch
description: zMath_Mat_TransformNormalBatch transforms zVec3 normals by the current matrix rotation, or copies them unchanged when the current matrix is marked identity.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zMath matrix helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath matrix/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x474710 validates the fastcall signature with normals in ecx, outNormals in edx, count on the stack, identity-path rep movs copy of count * sizeof(zVec3), zero-count return on the non-identity path, and per-normal x/y/z dot products using the current matrix 3x3 without translation.
The native zMath smoke verifies identity copy, non-identity two-normal rotation using the current matrix 3x3, and zero-count no-op behavior.
